refresh_policy: No automatic expected-digest refresh. An intentional canonical change needs owner approval, explicit pin update, byte-equality gate and new source-bound qualification.
required_gate: Root/CLI package-source gate must take explicit repository root, compare original/moved canonical Git bytes and working bytes with this replica and pinned SHA256/provenance before qualification/archive, refusing absent roots/canonical inputs, drift or mismatches. Normal SDK builds must not read CLI source.
